hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler Finance lending vaults. It fully handles swap execution in beforeSwap using a proprietary curve invariant, depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to the pool manager. Each pool is a delegatecall proxy instance of this implementation.
